summary: Solo 43-year-old climber fell 500-1,000 ft from the ridgeline while traversing between South and North Maroon Peak; witnessed by a pair on the summit.
location: Ridgeline between South Maroon Peak and North Maroon Peak, Elk Range
responding_agency: Pitkin County Sheriff; Mountain Rescue Aspen; U.S. Army National Guard HAATS helicopter; CareFlight of the Rockies
notes: Call at ~12:30pm Thursday from witnesses; MRA team lowered by long line from HAATS helicopter at ~2:54pm and confirmed deceased; body hoisted out and flown to Aspen airport; victim from Niwot, CO. 2026-09-20: merged MRA FB post permalink (MRA press release (DATE OF INCIDENT 11/05/2020; solo male climber fell 500-1000 ft from th).
